failure_taxonomy.measured_local_failure: Compare raw candidate recall before scoring; M15 replaced global proposals with local-only proposals and reused high visual thresholds; local crops change apparent scale and lack verified crop-specific calibration. Global recovery prevents permanent lock but cannot recover visually unproposed balls. Exact counters above quantify losses without assigning unverified causes.
failure_taxonomy.gru_failure: VAL mean endpoint error worse at all horizons; TEST region radii extremely broad. Only199 train histories from one game, overlapping frames, no visual input, exposure/domain shift; these are design limitations, not experimentally isolated causes.
failure_taxonomy.ground: M14 accepted416 image observations, zero near-foot contact; no independent metric references/height calibration. Camera alone cannot determine ball height.
failure_taxonomy.training_quality: One game/two short clips; positive repeated stationary balls; random and person crops are not verified negatives. M16 must not repeat unknown-visibility negative labeling.
